mapper.insert: INSERT INTO basic_user_session ( user_id, session_key, refresh_token, ip_address, user_agent, login_at, last_access_at, status, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{sessionKey}, #{refreshToken}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, NOW(), NOW(), #{status}, #{expiresAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE basic_user_session SET last_access_at = NOW() WHERE session_key = #{sessionKey} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE basic_user_session SET status = 'LOGOUT', logout_at = NOW() WHERE session_key = #{sessionKey}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM basic_user_session WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE basic_user_session SET status = 'LOGOUT', logout_at = NOW() WHERE id = ( SELECT id FROM basic_user_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM basic_user_session WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
